# Wikipedia fixtures

Real responses from `https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/<title>` for
`Homo_sapiens`, `Pan`, `Pan_(genus)` and `Eukaryota`, captured for the tests and trimmed to the
fields the code reads (extracts cut to their first sentence).

Wikipedia text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/);
the images these responses point to are not bundled.
